## Equations
### EQ001 — Finite-chain Aubry-Andre Hamiltonian

*Defines the quasiperiodic single-particle lattice and its localization transition.*

$$
H_{AA}=-J\sum_{\langle j,j'\rangle}(|j\rangle\langle j'|+\mathrm{h.c.})+\chi\sum_{j=0}^{L-1}\cos(2\pi\gamma j)|j\rangle\langle j|
$$

status: `verified` · source: paper_equation: Published Eq. (1); arXiv source label e2

Numerical form:

```
Real symmetric nearest-neighbor matrix with diagonal chi*cos(2*pi*gamma*j), off-diagonal -J, and an optional periodic closing bond selected per target.
```

Code: `src/ldsi_model.py::aa_hamiltonian`


### EQ002 — Generalized Aubry-Andre corrections

*Creates the GAA mobility edge used in Fig. 2.*

$$
H'=J_2\sum_j(|j\rangle\langle j+2|+\mathrm{h.c.})+\chi'\sum_j\cos(4\pi\gamma j)|j\rangle\langle j|+J'\sum_j\cos2\pi\gamma(j+1/2)
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ001` · source: paper_equation: Published Eq. (2); arXiv source label e3

Numerical form:

```
Real symmetric pentadiagonal matrix added to EQ001.
```

Code: `src/ldsi_model.py::gaa_hamiltonian`


### EQ003 — Steady-state cavity amplitude

*Maps an atomic density profile to the complex cavity field and photon number.*

$$
a=-\frac{\eta N\Theta}{-\Delta_c-i\kappa+UNB},\quad \Theta=\langle\psi|C|\psi\rangle,\quad B=\langle\psi|C^2|\psi\rangle,\quad C_{jj}=\cos(2\pi\gamma_c j)
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ001` · source: paper_equation: Published Eq. (3); supplement_equation: Supplement Eq. (S5)

Numerical form:

```
Evaluate Theta and B from a normalized real orbital, then evaluate the printed complex rational function.
```

Code: `src/ldsi_model.py::steady_cavity_field`


### EQ004 — Cavity scattering overlaps and susceptibility channels

*Connects the AA/GAA eigenstates to the cavity-induced linear response.*

$$
S_{\alpha\beta}=\langle\alpha|C|\beta\rangle,\quad H_{\alpha\beta}=\langle\alpha|C^2|\beta\rangle,\quad f_1^{\beta}=|S_{0\beta}|^2/(\epsilon_\beta-\epsilon_0),\quad f_1=\sum_{\beta>0}f_1^{\beta}
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ001`, `EQ002` · source: paper_equation: Published Eqs. (4)-(6) and definitions below Eq. (6)

Numerical form:

```
Diagonalize H, form S=V.T @ diag(C) @ V, and divide squared row-0 overlaps by excitation energies.
```

Code: `src/ldsi_model.py::scattering_response`


### EQ005 — Linear superradiant threshold

*Turns the cavity susceptibility into the critical pump plotted in Figs. 2-4.*

$$
\eta_c=\sqrt{\frac{\kappa^2+\bar\Delta_c^2}{-4Nf_1\bar\Delta_c}},\qquad \bar\Delta_c=\Delta_c-UNh_0,\quad h_0=1/2
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ003`, `EQ004` · source: paper_equation: Published Eq. (7) and the linearization of Eqs. (3)-(6)

Numerical form:

```
Use the literal one-factor detuning in every scientific array. The factor-two branch is evaluated only after the numerical outputs are frozen, as a hypothesis for the stable Fig. 3(a)/Fig. 4(b) normalization conflict.
```

Code: `src/ldsi_model.py::critical_pump`


### EQ006 — Localization-driven resonant self-scattering

*Defines the central mechanism: a localized state has finite diagonal cavity overlap and therefore a resonant zero-denominator channel.*

$$
\mathrm{IPR}_\alpha=\sum_j|\phi_j^\alpha|^4,\qquad f_{\alpha,\mathrm{self}}=|S_{\alpha\alpha}|^2/(\epsilon_\alpha-\epsilon_\alpha)\rightarrow\infty,\qquad \eta_c\rightarrow0
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ004`, `EQ005` · source: paper_method: Fig. 2 discussion and paragraphs below Fig. 3

Numerical form:

```
At finite L, classify localization from IPR rather than treating small boundary-induced S_alphaalpha as a true thermodynamic self channel; assign eta_c=0 to localized states.
```

Code: `src/ldsi_model.py::inverse_participation_ratio`, `src/ldsi_model.py::state_resolved_thresholds`


### EQ007 — Momentum distribution and channel indices

*Explains the momentum peaks and the three dominant scattering channels in Fig. 3.*

$$
P_\alpha(q)=L^{-1}|\sum_j\phi_j^\alpha e^{i\pi jq}|^2,\quad \alpha_0=2L(1-\gamma_c),\quad \alpha_1=2L(\gamma_c-\gamma),\quad \alpha_2=2L(\gamma_c+2\gamma-2)
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ001`, `EQ004` · source: paper_method: Fig. 3 discussion and caption

Numerical form:

```
Evaluate the direct Fourier sum on q in [-2,2] and calculate per-eigenstate f1 channels from EQ004.
```

Code: `src/ldsi_model.py::momentum_distribution`


### EQ008 — Self-consistent mean-field orbital

*Defines the nonlinear fixed point used for the photon-number and density panels.*

$$
H_{\mathrm{eff}}(a)=H_{AA}+2\eta\mathrm{Re}(a)C+U|a|^2C^2,\qquad |\psi\rangle=\operatorname*{groundstate}H_{\mathrm{eff}}[a(\psi)]
$$

status: `reconstructed` · derived from: `EQ001`, `EQ003` · source: paper_equation: Published dynamic potential preceding Eq. (1); supplement_equation: Supplement Eqs. (S1)-(S5) and Fig. S1 discussion

Numerical form:

```
Iterate cavity field and the lowest eigenvector with damping; use continuation from the superradiant side to avoid losing the broken-symmetry branch. Exact iteration tolerance and pump samples are case-local reconstruction details.
```
